```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import pandas as pd

root = Path(os.environ["PRISM_FLOW_ROOT"])
validation = json.loads((root / "results/metadata/validation.json").read_text())
qc = pd.read_csv(root / "results/qc/qc_gate.tsv", sep="\t")
de = pd.read_csv(root / "results/bulk/deseq2/results_full.tsv", sep="\t")
sig = pd.read_csv(root / "results/bulk/deseq2/results_significant.tsv", sep="\t")
```

## Scope

This report is produced by an **independent portfolio demonstrator**. It contains synthetic demo data by default and is **not a clinical decision-support report**.

## Run summary

```{python}
summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "Metric": ["Metadata status", "Samples", "QC PASS", "QC WARN", "QC FAIL", "Significant DE genes"],
    "Value": [
        validation["status"],
        validation["sample_count"],
        int((qc["qc_status"] == "PASS").sum()),
        int((qc["qc_status"] == "WARN").sum()),
        int((qc["qc_status"] == "FAIL").sum()),
        len(sig),
    ],
})
summary
```

qc[["sample_id", "library_size", "detected_genes", "zero_fraction", "qc_status", "qc_reasons"]]

## Differential expression

The analysis compares the configured contrast using DESeq2. Samples marked `FAIL` by the QC gate are excluded before model fitting.

```{python}
cols = [c for c in ["gene_id", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj"] if c in de.columns]
de.sort_values("padj", na_position="last")[cols].head(20)
```

## Reproducibility and traceability

The workflow records software environment files, logs, benchmarks, Git commit (when available), input/output paths and timestamps. The final table is written to `provenance/execution_trace.tsv`.

## Platform extension pattern

The implemented bulk RNA-seq path is the reference modality. New modalities should implement the same contracts: **metadata validation → processing → QC state → provenance → versioned results → reportable summary**.
